`final class JournalGlBinding`<br/>
**Implements:** [`IGlBinding`](/reference/base-opengl/iglbinding/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.base.opengl.render.state` · **Module:** `base-opengl` · **Source:** [JournalGlBinding.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/base/opengl/src/main/java/dev/joid/base/opengl/render/state/JournalGlBinding.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 2</span> <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 3</span>

An OpenGL binding that notes in a `GlStateJournal` every state that JOID changes, before passing the call on.

## Description

[`GlStateGuard`](/reference/base-opengl/glstateguard/) wraps the binding of the backend in it, and [`GlRenderBridge.getBinding`](/reference/base-opengl/glrenderbridge/#GlRenderBridge-method-getBinding) returns it, so that every change that JOID makes during a frame can be given back to the host.
Queries and creations pass through unchanged.

## Learn more

- [The state journal](/build/embedding-in-a-host/#the-state-journal)

---

<small>`fluent` returns the instance, typed for chaining · `factory` creates an instance · `signal` also accepts a value that follows signals, as a signal, an expression or a lambda ([When does JOID compute this value again?](/use/learn/interactivity/signals/#ask-when-does-joid-compute-this-value-again)) · `hook` called by JOID, override it · `abstract` you implement it · `default` interface method with a body · `static` called on the class · `protected` visible to subclasses</small>
